comments.author: backlog
comments.text: REVIEW FIX: Added adapter regression for the actual restart symptom: agent_end with assistant stopReason=aborted and no ctx.signal pauses the goal and sends no tau:goal-continuation. Test: extensions/tau/test/goal-adapter.test.ts 'does not continue the goal when an aborted agent end has no pi signal'. Reviewer approved with no P0/P1 findings.

comments.author: backlog
comments.text: CORRECTION: User clarified assistant/API stopReason=aborted must not drive goal state. Reworked fix so goal pause is driven by pi runtime AbortSignal captured during before_agent_start. The abort listener records the interrupt before pi clears the active run, so later turn_end/agent_end cannot auto-continue. Added tests proving assistant stopReason=aborted without pi interrupt does not pause the goal.
